cards.title:
WAKE UP
THE TAIL!
cards.body:
Shake your phone to fill the charge meter.
Yes, enthusiasm counts.

cards.title:
GREEN
MEANS GO!
cards.body:
Stop shaking inside the green zone for a perfect launch.
Too early: sleepy. Too late: crispy.

cards.title:
LEAN
INTO IT
cards.body:
Tilt left and right to dodge the squishy stuff.
Your phone moves. You don’t have to.

cards.title:
SPEED OR
STEERING
cards.body:
While shaking, Spermy swims straight. Release to aim.
Multitasking is overrated.

cards.title:
ONE JOB.
ONE OVUM.
cards.body:
Dodge, recharge, and reach the glowing ovum first.
No pressure. You’re only one in a million.
cards.callout: PRACTICE RUN • NO RANKING • NO SHAME
